verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts: dropping a `SKILL.md` into a skills directory is enough for Claude to add it to its toolkit, so an agent that can write files can install a skill without prompts. There is also a programmatic Skills API for uploads and a `--plugin-dir` flag for loading plugins. However, the documented marketplace path uses in-session `/plugin marketplace add` and `/plugin install` slash commands, and nothing explicitly describes a headless, promptless install an agent runs end to end. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented non-interactive install command or flag for agents, confirmation that plugin/marketplace install runs headlessly without prompts, and hands-on corroboration of agents self-installing skills.
